description_en: Edits the common filter conditions for host assets
description_zh: 编辑主机资产常用筛选条件
name: ModifySearchCondition

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The name of the common filter condition
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions. This parameter is in JSON format. Pay attention to the letter case when you specify this parameter. The following fields are included:

filterParams: The filter parameters. This parameter is in JSON format. The following fields are included:
label: The display name for the search in the console.
value: The filter parameter condition. This parameter is in JSON format. The following fields are included:

     - name: The filter condition field. For more information about the valid values of this field, see the description below.
     - value: The value that corresponds to the filter condition field.

LogicalExp: The logical relationship between multiple filter conditions. Valid values:
OR: or
AND: and
Valid values of name:
If Type is set to ecs, call the [DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~) operation to query the supported search conditions.
If Type is set to cloud_product, call the [GetCloudAssetCriteria](~~GetCloudAssetCriteria~~) operation to query the supported search conditions
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件。该参数JSON格式，输入参数时注意大小写。包含以下字段：

filterParams：过滤参数。该参数JSON格式。包含以下字段：
label：控制台搜索展示名称。
value：过滤参数条件。该参数JSON格式。包含以下字段：

     - name：筛选条件字段，该字段取值详见说明。
     - value：筛选条件字段对应值。

LogicalExp：多条件筛选时，条件之间的关系。取值：
OR：或
AND：且
name取值。
Type为ecs时，您可以调用[DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~)接口查询支持的搜索条件。
Type为cloud_product时，您可以调用[GetCloudAssetCriteria](~~GetCloudAssetCriteria~~)接口查询支持的搜索条件
parameters.name: filter_conditions

parameters.help_en:
The asset type. Default value: ecs. Valid values:
ecs: host asset
cloud_product: cloud service
parameters.help_zh:
资产类型。默认为ecs。取值：
ecs：主机资产
cloud_product：云产品
parameters.name: type

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
